trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible upper boundaries of both lobe tips exhibit high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; left lobe tip displays approximately 7 distinct triangular peaks, while the right lobe tip displays a more irregular, jagged topography with approximately 6 distinct peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal segments of the fluke show a sharp convex upward trajectory terminating in concentrated white pixel clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters forming dense circular and semi-spherical aggregates (barnacles) are concentrated at the terminal distal points of both visible lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization by sessile barnacles at the lateral tips of the fluke, appearing as dense white calcareous clusters against the dark grey/black dorsal skin.
other_distinctive_markers: The vertical orientation of the lobe tips relative to the waterline suggests a diving or 'fluking' posture, though the central fluke body remains submerged.
